quote.text: The most important figures that one needs for management are unknown or unknowable, but successful management must nevertheless take account of them.
quote.author: Lloyd S. Nelson, quoted by W. Edwards Deming in Out of the Crisis (1986)

stories.kicker: Singapore · Eight Officers, One Working Paper
stories.headline: Eight public officers referred to the police
stories.dek: The study behind them thanks six academics who say they had nothing to do with it — and its S$270 million is what the flats cost, not what anyone made.

stories.kicker: The Rabbit Hole · Listening to Spacecraft
stories.headline: A picture of the Earth falls onto your screen
stories.dek: No licence, no transmitter, no exam. A stick of silicon, a wire on a pole, and ten minutes of a satellite crossing your sky — and the network you join has four and a half thousand stations, of which under three hundred are awake.

stories.kicker: The Undercurrent · Laos and Order Forty
stories.headline: A country stopped importing petrol cars to defend its currency
stories.dek: Laos is the first state in Asia to shut its border to combustion vehicles. It did it to stop paying for fuel in dollars — and the suspension expires in twelve weeks, with a prime minister three days into the job.

stories.kicker: The World · Hormuz, Day Two Hundred and Twenty
stories.headline: Twelve attacks last week. Or nine. Or seven
stories.dek: The worst week for tanker strikes since February, on a count nobody shares. Washington calls the strait open, Tehran calls it closed, and both are describing the same ships.

stories.headline: The number on the box is the one that means least
stories.dek: Eighteen-ten and eighteen-eight are essentially the same steel, says the British industry’s own association. The figure that does separate the tiers is printed by almost nobody.

stories.kicker: Technology · The Chips Nobody Buys Outright
stories.headline: Sixty billion dollars, secured on chips nobody can price
stories.dek: Broadcom supplies the processors, leases them, lends against them and guarantees what they will be worth. Its customer’s own prospectus calls that a potential conflict of interest.

stories.kicker: The Kit · Six Thousand Dollars, No Benchmarks
stories.headline: The one specification that decides it is missing
stories.dek: Microsoft opened pre-orders on Tuesday for a desktop built to hold a hundred-and-twenty-billion-parameter model. Five sources, including its own and Nvidia’s, publish no memory bandwidth.

stories.kicker: The Good Life · A Watch With Three Ratings
stories.headline: Seiko’s own pages disagree on how wet it can get
stories.dek: A panda-faced chronograph, five thousand pieces, five hundred and ninety euros. The maker lists it as splash resistant, as three bar, and as thirty metres, depending which page you open.

stories.kicker: Screen & Sound · The Audience That Liked It
stories.headline: Seventy-three per cent, from almost nobody
stories.dek: The people who paid for this weekend’s Iñárritu picture rated it twenty-one points above the critics. Its Saturday takings fell below its Friday, which is not a thing word of mouth does.

stories.kicker: The Family Desk · Her Phone, At Twelve
stories.headline: Seven in ten already had one at twelve
stories.dek: A cohort of nearly nine thousand children says owning a phone at twelve tracks eating-disorder symptoms two years later. The ratios are large; the absolute numbers are small. Both are true.

stories.kicker: The Macro Desk · The Window You Choose
stories.headline: Pick the start date and the answer changes
stories.dek: Almost the whole rise in the ten-year is real yield. Whether that is ninety-one per cent or a hundred depends entirely on where you begin counting.

stories.kicker: Fitness · The Lever That Does Nothing
stories.headline: Your strength swings eleven per cent. Train anyway
stories.dek: A Basel trial timed older adults’ training to their own measured best and worst hours for twelve weeks. Three confidence intervals, all straddling zero.

stories.headline: The race is this weekend and the walkabouts are going
stories.dek: Every row below was put back to a promoter, a venue or an official box office this morning. Two of the biggest names in the window publish no price at all.
